title: ROOT CAUSE: worktree/main state.json split — Mission Control shows wrong/duplicate session status
description: The agent runs in a git worktree; its checkpoints write session id ...19-45-37... while the daemon/runtime-writer (started from MAIN repo) forwards a different, stale session ...20-16-58... from main .holistic-local/state.json. Result: 2 Mission Control cards for 1 real session, neither tracking real-time running/waiting. THE true root cause of 'dashboard does not reflect actual agent status'. Fix: unify the state.json the live agent uses with the one the daemon/writer forwards (worktree-aware resolution OR single canonical state). Full details: .holistic-local/context/andon-status-investigation.md

title: Worktree hook propagation: install per-agent turn hooks into active worktrees at install time
description: installAndonHooks() must also enumerate active git worktrees (git worktree list --porcelain) and install per-agent hook config into each worktree's agent config path. Add a git post-checkout hook so newly-created worktrees get hooks at creation time. Without this, turn hooks (Stop/UserPromptSubmit) never fire in worktree sessions because hooks bind at session startup and the worktree has no per-agent settings file.
notes: Depends on holistic-58k (state.json unification must land first so there is a single session to write turn_state into). For Claude: enumerate worktrees and write .claude/settings.json into each. The install_targets field in the adapter turn_hook_config (main + worktrees) drives which targets the installer writes to. The git post-checkout hook re-runs the installer when a new worktree is created.

title: Fix stuck Fleet objective and parked status drift in Andon live board
description: Mission Control repeatedly shows the same stale card as active context: "cursor · Parked · Implementing M007: Event Forwarding (Daemon & Wrappers)" even after new work, restarts, and refresh. Live board behavior is still being influenced by stale legacy/session narrative events or stale activeSession carryover instead of authoritative runtime truth. This erodes operator trust in Andon's real-time supervision role.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Fleet live status/objective comes from runtime harness truth (runtime_sessions + runtime_processes + runtime_events) only. 2) A stale legacy objective cannot remain pinned after runtime status changes. 3) "needs_input" and "flowing" states require current runtime evidence (waiting/running + fresh heartbeat), not historical question/resume markers. 4) If runtime feed is unavailable, board shows explicit disconnected/degraded runtime state instead of stale inferred activity. 5) Regression tests cover the stuck-objective scenario and prevent recurrence.

- Verify remote and stateRef are interpolated correctly at generation time vs. runtime

### Slice 2 — Add sync verification to holistic status

- This ensures state is always pushed when code is pushed

### Slice 4 — Add requestAutoSync() error surface

- checkpoint → verify script runs → verify refs/holistic/state exists on remote
- Test on both Windows (ps1) and Unix (sh)
